note: Friday A, workplace English（职场英语）: 事 si6 ×3, then BBC 6 Minute English “Is it OK to disagree?” (~6 min). Hard recall only (no new cards). Sets of 3–4, one-keyword cue, say each aloud before flipping, then a 3-beat run-through. Then a 30–60 sec end-of-week wrap: “Here's where I got to this week, and what I'll pick up next.” 加油！

tasks.prompt: Workplace output, 30–60 sec: end-of-week wrap. “Here's where I got to this week, and what I'll pick up next.” Point → reason → example. Say it aloud before opening the script.

Reason: I wanted a clear picture before I try to improve anything.
Example: Next week I'll pick up those notes and turn one of the steps into a short checklist.
